purpose: Canonical terrain contract for the active PCTA Burney Falls PCT access to Ash Camp itinerary.

route.name: Burney Falls PCT access to Ash Camp
route.geometrySource: PCTA authoritative Centerline Feature Service, calibrated to PCTA 2026 half-mile markers
route.elevationSource: USGS 3DEP elevation service (bare-earth DEM); retained Garmin tracks are comparison evidence
route.elevationMethod: 25m resampling, centered 200m moving mean, continuous 20ft hysteresis carried across day boundaries

pcta.serviceDescription: PCTA's authoritative PCT Centerline dataset. This data was originally created using Halfmile's 2018 data release, and updated with all recent reroutes incorporated into the data from 2021, 2022, 2023, and 2024.

dayBoundaries.name: Pre-private USFS dry camp
dayBoundaries.notes: Shasta County parcel screen: USFS APN 022-170-001. Candidate is about 250 ft from the PCT, 626 ft from the mapped MVUM road, 0.363 mi from mapped private property, and 5.0% mean sampled slope. Confirm vegetation, hazards, durable surface, and three-person capacity on foot.

dayBoundaries.name: Bartle Gap planned pickup / re-entry
dayBoundaries.notes: This is a required itinerary handoff, not a campsite or a casual bailout: immediate Day 3 pickup, legal off-corridor overnight, then Day 4 return to this exact pin. The driver, vehicle route, gate status, pickup window, and no-contact fallback must be confirmed before the trip.

methodology.resampling: Route is sampled at a fixed 25m physical interval with every official day boundary inserted exactly.
methodology.smoothing: A centered 200m moving mean produces the display/metric terrain curve from USGS 3DEP values.
methodology.accumulation: A single 20ft hysteresis accumulator continues across all day boundaries so a campsite split cannot create fake climbing.
methodology.accuracyNote: Geometry and route mileage are authoritative PCTA references. Cumulative climbing is model-derived and should be reported with method/version, not as impossible foot-level certainty.
